registration.checkSpam: If the message does not arrive within a few minutes, look in the junk mail as well.
registration.resent: The confirmation has been sent again. If it still does not arrive within a few minutes, write to us at info@balkanskatrkackaliga.net.

registration.closedText: From 15 to 30 September the portal is open for looking around only. The calendar and the boards work, but no membership is sold then.
registration.serbianBinds: If the Serbian and the English version of this statement differ, the Serbian text is the one that binds.
registration.doneReferral: The application is recorded as a referral. The member who invited you is credited once your fee is activated.
registration.fatherNameHint: Needed to join the association under the law.

teams.proposeNote2: The team exists only once a moderator approves it. Until then it is not visible anywhere on the portal.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.neededText: This part of the portal is seen by members only.
signIn.noRecordText: You are signed in, but there is no competitor record on this account, so there is nothing to show here.
signIn.needsBoth: Enter an address and a password so that you can sign in.
signIn.refused: The sign-in did not succeed. The address or the password is wrong, or the account is locked for a while after too many failed attempts.
signIn.noWho: The sign-in went through, but the portal did not manage to learn who you are. Refresh the page, and if it happens again, let us know.

newPassword.title: A new password
newPassword.intro: Enter a new password for your account and repeat it.
newPassword.passwordHint: At least {count} characters. There is no other condition, but the password must not be one that has already appeared in publicly published breaches.
newPassword.done: The password is set. You can sign in now.
newPassword.noToken: This address carries no link from a message, so there is nothing to set. Open the link in the message the portal sent you.
newPassword.linkIsNotValid: The link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.
newPassword.formIsNotComplete: Both passwords must be filled in, the same, and at least {count} characters long.
newPassword.passwordHasLeaked: This password has already appeared in publicly published breaches, so the portal does not take it. Choose another.

confirmAddress.title: Address confirmation
confirmAddress.working: We are confirming the address, just a moment.
confirmAddress.done: The address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
confirmAddress.noToken: This address carries no link from a message, so there is nothing to confirm. Open the link in the message the portal sent you.
confirmAddress.linkIsNotValid: The link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.

server.refused: The server refused the request with the reason {reason}, which this screen does not recognise.
server.rejected: The portal did not manage to prove to the server that the request comes from this page. Refresh the page and try again.
server.wrong: The server answered with the number {status} and nothing was changed. Try again in a few minutes.
server.nothing: The portal did not manage to reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

myProfile.notificationsNote: Six obligatory emails cannot be switched off: the account confirmation, a password change, a result entered and a result changed, a further request to check something, and a major change on the portal. Everything else is below.

notify.resultApproved: When a result of mine is approved
notify.resultChanged: When somebody changes a result of mine

myResults.title: My results
myResults.noneSent: No result has been sent to be checked yet.

newResult.title: Entering a result
newResult.note: The result enters the boards only once an administrator approves it. While it waits, only you see it.
newResult.again: You are correcting a result that was refused. The reason was: {reason}
newResult.changing: You are changing a result that is still waiting to be checked. Once you send it, it goes back to the end of the queue.
newResult.fixingCounted: You are changing a result that is already counted. Until the change is approved, it leaves the standing, and new proof has to go with it.
newResult.needsProof: A change to a counted result must carry a link to the official results or a picture as proof.
newResult.needsTime: A time must be entered. Hours, minutes and seconds cannot all be zero.
newResult.pointsNotFinal: The reckoning is not final. The League confirms it at verification, and the number can change.
newResult.againDone: The result has been sent to be checked again.
newResult.raceKindHint: A race by length has a set length, a race by time a set duration, and a free race has no specification.
newResult.link: A link to the official results
newResult.linkHint: Required, unless you attach pictures of the results or of an app as proof.
newResult.donePoints: This race brings you {points} BTL points.
newResult.doneWaiting: A moderator is checking it. Once it is confirmed, it enters the boards and your profile.
newResult.photoHint: A shot from a watch, a certificate or something else. A comment becomes required, and the link to the results becomes optional.

membership.title: My fee
membership.feeExempt: You are exempt from paying the fee for season {season}, by a decision of the Board.
membership.notYetSold: The fee is not on sale yet. Collection starts on 1 October.
membership.junior: Anybody who is fourteen or younger on at least one day of the season pays {eur} EUR, and {rsd} RSD from Serbia, whatever the date of payment.
membership.byCountry: The ways of paying depend on the country on your profile ({country}).
membership.ips: A payment slip with a QR code
membership.ipsNote: Scan the code in your bank's app. The amount, the payee and the reference number are already filled in.
membership.cardNote: Card payment goes through a provider, on the provider's page. Card details never pass through the portal. A provider has not been chosen yet.
membership.paypalNote: The account is a business one, in the name of the BTL sports association. PayPal is not offered to members from Serbia, because paying with it between residents of Serbia is not allowed.
membership.ipsQrLabel: The IPS QR code for the payment slip
membership.showPayload: Show the contents of the code
membership.renewalOpen: Renewal is open. You do not register again: the member number, the profile and the history stay yours.
membership.renewalShut: Renewal opens on 1 October and lasts until 31 December.
membership.chooseCategory: Which category you compete in for {season}.
membership.firstSeasonOpen: The rookie category is still open to you, because you have not finished any official season with {points} points or more.
membership.firstSeasonClosed: The rookie category is closed to you, because you finished an official season with {points} points or more. Leaving it cannot be undone.
membership.noTeam: You are not in any team at the moment.
membership.inTeam: You are in the team {team} at the moment.
membership.transferOpen: The transfer window is open until 31 December at 23.59. The change takes effect on 1 January {season}.
membership.transferShut: The transfer window is closed. It opens on 1 October and lasts until 31 December. If nothing is agreed by then, you stay where you are.
membership.askToJoin: Send a request to the team
membership.referenceNote: The reference number is what a payment is recognised by. Without it the fee arrives, but there is no telling whose it is.
membership.priceNow: Today the fee costs {eur} EUR, and {rsd} RSD from Serbia.
membership.costs: A payment in euros also carries a payment processing charge of {fee} EUR, which is not part of the fee but the cost of processing at the payment intermediary, and the exchange difference and your bank's charge remain yours. A payment in dinars carries neither a charge nor an exchange difference.
membership.referralNote: Everybody who joins through your link and activates a fee brings you {amount} onto your balance. Not at the moment of the application but once the fee is activated.
membership.balanceNote: The balance pays for future fees. It is not paid out in money and is not transferred to another member.
membership.feeExemptNoRenewal: You are exempt from paying the fee, so there is nothing to pay.

review.title: The queue for checking results
review.empty: There is no result waiting at all.
review.newRaceTitle: This race is not in the calendar. Approving it creates the event and the race.

sweptLeft.one: {count} report is left from races that are not in the calendar. Such a report is approved on its own, because doing so creates the event and the race.
sweptLeft.few: {count} reports are left from races that are not in the calendar. Each is approved on its own, because doing so creates the event and the race.
sweptLeft.other: {count} reports are left from races that are not in the calendar. Each is approved on its own, because doing so creates the event and the race.

review.amendNote: You are changing what the competitor reported, before you decide. The kind he chose is only a hint. On a race by time the time is the duration of the race, the same for everybody who finished.
review.reasonPlaceholder: Nothing is refused without a reason. The member receives your reason in a message.
review.reasonKeptPlaceholder: Nothing is refused without a reason. No message goes out, because there is nobody to send it to.
review.instructionPlaceholder: Write exactly what has to change in the picture for it to be accepted.
review.unusableLink: The member sent an address the portal does not open.

statement.title: A bank statement
statement.taken: The statement {name} has been taken. Reconciling by reference number will be the server's work; until then you confirm payments by hand.
statement.wrongKind: A statement must be a PDF. This file is not, so it was not taken.

review.reasonNeeded: Enter a reason so that you can send.

admin.title: Administration
admin.eventTaken: An event with that name already exists in that year. Change the name or the year: the address is made from the name and the year.
admin.noRaces: This event has no race yet.
admin.waitingForResults: Deleting is waiting for the results
admin.resultsFailed: Deleting is not possible: the results cannot be loaded
admin.ofMany: of {count} in all. Narrow the search to see the others.

form.savedNote: This has been kept. Check the values; if something is not right, go back to the list and open the record again.
form.nextSeason: The same place in the calendar next year
form.nextWeek: Exactly seven days after the event copied
form.racesRefused: Every race must have a name and a day; the fields marked show what is still missing. The ascent and the descent may stay empty; they are then read as 0.

field.categoryFromDistance: It will be set once a length is entered

admin.pricingFixed: The periods are fixed and repeat every year, so rows are neither added nor deleted. What changes is the prices and the names of the periods.
admin.processingFee: A payment in euros is larger on the statement by a payment processing charge of {fee} EUR. The charge is not part of the fee and is not entered in the price list.
admin.raceTaken: This event already has a race of that length on that day. Nobody can tell apart two races that differ in nothing at all.
admin.referralNote: The amount put onto the referrer's balance once a new member's fee is activated. The price list is the source of that amount: the members' page and the terms of use speak of it. It is set up to 1 October, for the season that then begins to be renewed; from that day it stands.
admin.referralSettled: The referral amount for season {season} does not change any more. The renewal of that season has been open since 1 October, and the amount is set up to that day.
admin.referralOpen: The amount you enter now holds for season {season}, because it is set up to 1 October. The portal remembers one amount and does not remember the earlier ones, so the same entry also changes the amount that stands from this moment on. An amount per season comes with the database.
admin.referralRunning: Season {season} is already under way. Its amount was locked on 1 October of the year before, and this entry changes it all the same, because the portal holds one amount.
admin.dropRaceNamed: Drop the race {race} from the competition
admin.noEventsOfSeason: There is no event from season {season} in the calendar.
admin.leagueRaceAdded: The race has been added to the competition.
admin.leagueRaceDropped: The race has been dropped from the competition.

leagueRefused.theRaceIsNotOfTheLeaguesSeason: That race is not from the season of this competition.
leagueRefused.theEventHoldsNoRaces: That event has no race yet.
leagueRefused.theRaceIsNotKnown: The portal does not know that race.
leagueRefused.theEventIsNotKnown: The portal does not know that event.
leagueRefused.theRaceIsNotSaidOnce: Either the whole event or one race of it has to be chosen.
leagueRefused.unknown: The portal did not accept the change. Refresh the page and try again.

leagueSaveRefused.theFormIsNotComplete: A name, an address or a season is missing.
leagueSaveRefused.theAddressIsNotShaped: An address may have only lower-case letters and digits, with a single hyphen between them. It must neither begin nor end with a hyphen.
leagueSaveRefused.theAddressIsTaken: There is already a competition at that address.
leagueSaveRefused.theSeasonIsNotThisOneOrTheNext: A competition is made for the current or the next season only.
leagueSaveRefused.theSeasonIsFrozen: The season of this competition is frozen, so the competition is no longer changed. Deleting still works.
leagueSaveRefused.theSeasonCannotMoveWhileRacesCount: The season cannot be moved while the competition counts even one race. Drop the races first, then change the season.

admin.leagueSavedUnseen: The competition has been saved, but the portal cannot show it in this list. Refresh the page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: The settings hold for your account on every device.
settings.hideProfile: Hide my profile from visitors who are not signed in
settings.hideProfileNote: The name stays in the tables and on the boards, because without it ranking everybody together would lose its point. What is hidden is only your profile page, and only from those who are not signed in.

rights.title: Moderators' rights
rights.intro: A row is a moderator, a column is a right. A box is remembered the moment it is pressed, there is no button to save. The rights are in two groups because they are two different actions: editing changes a record, while deciding lets somebody else's work through or sends it back.
rights.superadminNote: The Superadmin is not in this table. He may do everything, always, so there is nothing to grant him or take from him.

verification.waitingForMembers: The decision is waiting for the list of members, so that it is known whether the applicant already has a team.
verification.membersFailed: A decision is not possible: the list of members cannot be loaded, and without it there is no telling whether the applicant already has a team.
verification.teamMemberHasTeam: The applicant is already in a team, so this proposal cannot be approved. A member may be in one team only.
verification.teamGone: The team this change applies to has been deleted in the meantime, so there is nothing to change. Refuse the change with an explanation.
verification.teamNotYours: This change was sent by a member who no longer administers that team, so it cannot be approved. Refuse the change with an explanation.
verification.title: Verification
verification.shortCount: One source of data is unavailable, so some numbers may be smaller than the real ones. Refresh the page; if it happens again, report the fault.
verification.empty: There is no item waiting at all.

approveAllAsk.one: Approve {count} item? This cannot be undone.
approveAllAsk.few: Approve {count} items? This cannot be undone.
approveAllAsk.other: Approve {count} items? This cannot be undone.

approveAllAskTeams.few: {count} items are waiting in the queue. Approve everything that can be approved? This cannot be undone.
approveAllAskTeams.other: {count} items are waiting in the queue. Approve everything that can be approved? This cannot be undone.

verification.subject: Subject
verification.teamChange: A change to an existing team
verification.teamChangeAccepted: The change to the team „{name}“ has been accepted
verification.teamChangeAcceptedBody: The details of the team „{name}“ have been changed. A moderator may correct what you sent before accepting it, so have a look at the team's page.
verification.sentByAnonymous: Reported by a visitor without an account
verification.fromResults: A result enters the tables only after approval
verification.fromPayments: A member becomes a full one once a payment is recorded
verification.fromTeams: A new team is approved by the Superadmin or by a moderator with the right over this queue
verification.fromProfiles: A member writes a text about themselves and sends a picture; both are approved or sent back with a reason that arrives in a message
verification.fromComments: A comment is accepted or deleted, at once and without an explanation
verification.deleteNotePlaceholder: Why it was taken down, for the moderators. It may stay empty.
verification.pictureAlt: The picture sent by {who}, with the part that will be seen framed
verification.resultReturned: The result has been sent back
verification.paymentReturned: The application has been sent back
verification.teamReturned: The team proposal has been sent back
verification.teamChangeReturned: The change to the team has been sent back
verification.bioReturned: The text about yourself has been sent back
verification.photoReturned: The profile picture has been sent back
verification.noRecipient: This item has no member for an answer to reach, so it is not refused from this queue. Approve it or report the fault; a message without a recipient would go to the whole League.
verification.noNumbersYet: No number has been given on this screen yet.
verification.activateAllPayment: Activate all on the basis of payment

activateAllAsk.one: Activate {count} membership on the basis of payment? Each one gets a member number and this cannot be undone.
activateAllAsk.few: Activate {count} memberships on the basis of payment? Each one gets a member number and this cannot be undone.
activateAllAsk.other: Activate {count} memberships on the basis of payment? Each one gets a member number and this cannot be undone.

verification.teamAcceptedBody: Your proposal for the team „{name}" has been accepted. You are its organiser.
verification.teamTaken: A team under this name, or under a name that gives the same address, already exists in the League. Correct the name or refuse the proposal.
verification.teamNoAddress: No page address can be made from this name. Correct the name so that it has at least one letter of our alphabet or of Cyrillic, or a digit, or refuse the proposal.
verification.teamIncomplete: The name, the town and the country must all be filled in for the team to come into being.
verification.teamNoMember: This proposal has no member who sent it, so there is nobody to be the organiser of the team and nobody to receive an answer.

awards.empty: This competitor has no trophy yet.
awards.noneInSeason: No trophy was won in the season chosen.

report.title: Reporting a result
report.note: You are reporting a result from the race {race}. The portal already knows the length, the ascent and the descent from the race itself.
report.noteTime: You are reporting a result from the race {race}. The portal already knows the time from the race itself and it is the same for everybody who finished; enter how far you got.
report.noteFree: You are reporting a result from the race {race}. This race sets neither a length nor a time, so enter both.
report.noRaces: This event has no race yet, so there is nothing to report.
report.noRace: A result is entered from the row of a race, on the event's page.

pager.leagueStanding: The pages of the competition standing

crop.framed: The part of the picture inside the circle is what will be seen. The rest is darkened, but still shows through.
crop.tooSmall: The picture is too small. Its shortest side has to be at least {least} pixels, so that the circle stays sharp everywhere it is shown.
crop.unreadable: This picture cannot be opened. Choose another one, in JPG or PNG form for instance.

bio.title: About yourself
bio.standing: This is what stands on your profile now. A change goes to a moderator for approval, and while it waits, the old text stays on the profile.
bio.none: You have not written anything about yourself yet. Once you send it, a moderator looks the text over before it appears on the profile.
bio.writeFirst: Write something so that you can send it.
bio.changeFirst: Change the text so that you have something to send.
bio.waitingNote: Your text is waiting for approval. If a moderator sends it back, the message says what you have to change.

picture.title: Profile picture
picture.none: The portal has no photograph yet, so the circle beside your name holds your initials. Send a picture and a moderator will look it over.
picture.waitingNote: Your picture is waiting for approval. If a moderator sends it back, the message says what you have to change.
picture.chooseFirst: Choose a picture so that you can send it.
picture.chosenAlt: The picture you chose, with the part that will be seen framed
picture.sentAlt: The picture you sent for approval, with the part that will be seen framed

account.personalNote: A change here takes effect at once, without approval. The picture and the text about yourself go to a moderator to be looked over, and there are separate sections for them below.
account.notShown: The portal is not showing you what is entered here at the moment. If you leave it empty, nothing changes; what you enter becomes the new value.
account.changeFirst: Change something so that you have something to save.
account.lockedTitle: Details that are not changed here
account.lockedNote: Gender and the date of birth are changed by the administration only, because the category and the age group are worked out from them. If a member changed them himself, he would be choosing which category he runs in and changing a standing already run, backwards.
account.birthDateNote: The date of birth is not shown here: the portal does not keep it with your public record, and the Statute asks that it not be shown either in full or in short. Public is only the category that follows from it.
account.cityNote: A town is chosen from the codebook of settlements, so for now it is changed through the administration. A town chooser on this screen does not exist yet.
account.emailNote: You change the email address yourself, but you have to confirm the new one, because it is also your sign-in to the portal. The confirmation has not been built yet, so the field is locked.
account.nothingToSave: The server found no change at all in the request. Refresh the page and try again.
account.fieldIsBlank: One of the required fields was left empty. Fill it in and save again.
account.fieldIsTooLong: One field is longer than the portal takes. Shorten it and save again.
account.notYoursToChange: Gender and the date of birth are changed by the administration only, so the server does not take that change.
account.townNotSaidOnce: A town has to be given exactly once: either from the codebook, or as a name entered together with a country.
account.townNotKnown: The server does not recognise the town or the country given. Choose a town from the codebook.
account.textIsTooLong: The text about yourself is longer than the portal takes. Shorten it and send again.
account.textAlreadyWaits: Your text is already waiting for approval, so a new one cannot be sent until it has been decided on.
account.passwordSignsOthersOut: When you change the password, you will be signed out on every other device. This one stays signed in.
account.passwordFillFirst: Fill in all three fields so that you can change the password.
account.passwordDone: The password has been changed. The other devices have been signed out.
account.passwordFormIsNotComplete: All three fields must be filled in, and the two new ones the same and at least {count} characters long.
account.oldPasswordIsWrong: The current password is not right. Try again.
account.passwordHasLeaked: This password has already appeared in publicly published breaches, so the portal does not take it. Choose another.
